verdict.rationale: Bitbucket documents a built-in CI/CD tool, Bitbucket Pipelines, for automated workflows on hosted or private runners, with visibility into pipeline status. The evidence never says pipelines are defined as code in the repository or that they trigger automatically on pushes and pull requests; both are only implied by "automated workflows." missing for 10: documentation of in-repo pipeline-as-code configuration, explicit push/PR trigger documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration
